choices.text: Eula, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: #This is... for me? Thank you, {NICKNAME}! This is the first time I've received something like this.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I didn't expect to run into you here. Amber and I just split up to go shopping. We're bringing back gifts for everyone at the Knights of Favonius.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Some small trinkets and toys. Oh, and some tea for Jean. It's from Qiaoying Village.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I heard that tea also has an energizing effect, so I thought it might be a nice change of pace for her.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Still, the brewing process for this kind of tea is pretty complicated. The vendor had to spend a lot of time explaining it to me.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Thankfully, I already knew a bit about tea etiquette, so I caught on relatively quick.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Here, this tea cake is for you — it's from Qiaoying Village. Amber really liked it, so I decided to buy some.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: We're going to check out the Mingxiao Lantern later. Maybe we'll ask someone to take a picture for us.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I would do it myself, but unfortunately, neither of us brought a Kamera.
